title: What Are You Wearing?
summary: Learn how to talk about everyday clothes. You will also learn how to use the verb wear.

sections.p: We wear different clothes every day. When it is hot, we wear a t-shirt and shorts. When it is cold, we wear a jacket and trousers. Look at your clothes right now. What do you have on? Learning these words helps you talk about your daily outfit easily with friends.

ex.en: I wear a blue shirt to work.
ex.mean: My work clothes include a blue shirt.

ex.en: She wears a red dress today.
ex.mean: Her outfit right now is a red dress.
His shoes are the color black.

sections.p: We often use colors to describe clothes. We put the color word before the clothing word. For example, we say blue jeans or a white hat. This makes your English more interesting and helps people understand exactly what you are wearing.

ex.mean: The hat is pink and she likes it.

sections.p: To talk about what you have on right now, use the verb wear. I wear, you wear, he wears, she wears. Remember to add an 's' for he and she! This is very useful when you go shopping or talk about the weather.

ex.en: What do you wear in summer?
ex.mean: Which clothes do you put on when the weather is hot?

ex.en: Today I wear a warm sweater.
ex.mean: Right now my outfit is a warm sweater.

tip: Look at your closet every morning and say the English names of your clothes out loud!

quiz.en: I put on my ___ on my feet.
She ___ a nice red dress today.
When it is very cold outside, I wear a warm ___.
My blue ___ are comfortable for walking.
___ do you wear in the summer?
He wears a white ___ with buttons to work.
